Lemma and boundary outputs are observable; analyzer, lexicon, rules, and lattice are unknown.

Provider geometry does not explain Nihongo's tappable token grouping; vertical cross-column behavior is an observed limitation.
Use only clips in the pinned licensed provider releases with per-file provenance; exact Nihongo clip identity and routing are not required.
